title: From brief to shipped
sideNote: Six steps, always in this order — boring on purpose.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: Who is this for, what breaks if it fails, what does “done” look like — until the real problem separates from the requested solution.
steps.output: Problem statement · Success criteria · Explicit non-goals

steps.title: Blueprint
steps.text: Data model, API surface and deployment shape decided up front — the expensive mistakes get made on paper, not in production.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Designed in the medium it ships in — real type, real breakpoints, real content. No pixel-perfect mockups that lie.
steps.output: Working UI · Design tokens · Motion spec

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The bulk of the work: features built end to end, tested as they land, reviewed against the written statement.

steps.title: Refine
steps.text: The part most teams skip — performance, edge cases, error states, and the hundred small things that make it feel finished.
steps.output: Perf budget met · Edge cases closed · Polish pass

steps.title: Ship
steps.text: Deployed, monitored and handed over — with the runbook, not just the repo.
